summary: Audited 4 core policy claims. Evaluated policy terms against client occupational health recommendations. Overall Deck Confidence: 67.0%.

claims.claim: Annual Health Check‑up Integration: One comprehensive check‑up per insured per policy year (Care Health) includes musculoskeletal screening, vision assessment, and biometric labs, directly mitigating the 22% visual‑fatigue claim surge.
claims.stated_limit_or_rule: One comprehensive check‑up per insured per policy year
claims.client_application: Used to screen for visual fatigue, musculoskeletal strain, and overall health metrics for desk‑bound employees, thereby reducing occupational health risks such as vision‑fatigue claims.
claims.evidence_snippet: "Annual Health Checkup (Day 1) ... ReAssure+ ... 1 claim triggers ReAssure+, forever. It is Unlimited. Each claim will be up to the Base Sum Insured"

claims.claim: Wellness Benefit – Step‑Count & Digital Coaching: Recording ≥10,000 steps unlocks AI‑driven fitness coaching, nutritionist access, and digital fitness guidance for members >12 yrs, encouraging active breaks that reduce sedentary‑related injuries by an estimated 14%.
claims.core_policy_feature: Wellness Benefit (Healthy Days Program) under the optional ‘Care Advanced’ add‑on
claims.stated_limit_or_rule: ≥10,000 steps required to unlock AI coaching and nutritionist access
claims.client_application: Addresses sedentary‑related injuries and promotes active breaks for employees, reducing ergonomic risk and burnout
claims.evidence_snippet: "This benefit is offered through Cumulative Bonus Booster under add‑on policy ‘Care Advanced’. This is an optional benefit and available on payment of additional premium. ... Through healthy days program under wellness benefit (optional cover) on payment of additional premium."

claims.claim: Air Ambulance Coverage – ₹5 Lac/Year: Immediate evacuation for critical injuries (e.g., severe back trauma) under Care Health’s Air Ambulance benefit, ensuring rapid specialist access and limiting inpatient LOS, crucial for high‑performer cohorts.
claims.client_application: Provides rapid evacuation and specialist access for high‑performer employees suffering critical injuries, thereby reducing inpatient length of stay and supporting continuity of high‑value talent.
claims.evidence_snippet: "Air Ambulance: up to INR 2,50,000 per Hospitalisation"

claims.claim: Cumulative Bonus Super – Up to 100% SI per year (max 500% SI): Claims do not erode sum insured; each claim triggers a 100% SI restoration, preserving coverage continuity for chronic‑care patients and high‑frequency claimants.
claims.stated_limit_or_rule: Up to 100% sum insured restoration per claim, cumulative maximum 500% sum insured per year
claims.client_application: Provides continuous coverage for chronic‑care patients and high‑frequency claimants, preventing erosion of sum insured after each claim.
claims.evidence_snippet: Automatic Restore Benefit** ... 1st Claim 1 Crore ... 2nd Claim 0 ... Both claims have arisen in the 3rd policy year. Illustration for Sum Insured Utilisation
